title: Space content
description: A Space Resource's view of another Space (ADR 0068, ADR 0079). The module declares spaceId as one outgoing Space reference that holds that Space's lifetime; the core checks existence, no cycles, lifetime and rooting (ADR 0074, ADR 0128). The module's own check is that map names a Map of that Space and graph a Graph that Map owns.

framing.description: The Map-coordinate centre and scale saved for this view; absent until framed, when the selected Map is fitted.
